document.about: True T-23-HC refrigerator spec sheet. Page 2 sets its features as bulleted lists under capital headings, each item's wrapped lines hanging just under an em in from its bullet, and each heading back at the bullets' x.

notes: #188: the heading after a list's last item, at the bullet's x with no bullet, passed the one-em indent tolerance and was read into the item.

checks.issue: `REFRIGERATION SYSTEM` was appended to the DESIGN list's last item: `… today’s food service marketplace. REFRIGERATION SYSTEM`.
`DOOR` was appended to the item before it: `… locks provided on front set. DOOR`.
`LIGHTING` was appended to the item before it: `… shelves are adjustable on 1/2" (13 mm) increments. LIGHTING`.
